Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. Zimbabwe have leveled the ODI series and made the contest exciting  for everyone. Sri Lanka on the other hand will want to brush this defeat aside and come back stronger when they take on the visitors for the series decider in Hambantota on the 10th of July at 0945 local (0415 GMT). Hope you liked our coverage of this match. Goodbye, take care and cheers!

Zimbabwe skipper, Graeme Cremer says that they were ahead when the rain was coming. Applauds his batsmen for batting really well. Mentions that they believe they can chase down the total so they are not under any pressure for the decider. Ends by saying that they pulled it back in the last 10 overs with the ball.

Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews says that it was disappointing as not many times a team scoring 300 ends up on the losing side. Credits Zimbabwe for how they batted but feels that their bowlers didn't hit the right areas. Praises Dickwella and Gunathilaka's knocks, which set up the platform for them. Adds that the pitch slowed down a touch later on. Ends by saying that they should step up their game for the series decider.

Man of the Match, Craig Ervine says that it wasn't too bad to come back after the break as they had the target in their mind. Reckons that they will look to perform their best and make it count in the decider.

After the break, the visitors had a target of 219 (DLS method) in 31 overs set in front of them. They were off to a shaky start as they lost Williams and Raza. However, amongst all this, Ervine kept his cool, scored an unbeaten half century and took his side across the finish line. Apart from Hasaranga, all the other bowlers didn't look much threatening. Malinga and Gunaratne were slightly better in terms of economy while Sandakan and debutant Fernando had a day to forget.

ZIMBABWE HAVE LEVELED THE SERIES 2-2! This pushes the series into the decider now. After not getting off to a good start, the visitors did well to restrict Sri Lanka to 300. Their openers then got off to a flier and kept the required run rate in check. However, both of them got out in quick succession which pegged them back. However, Musakanda and Ervine then added 46 runs to steady the ship. The former then lost his wicket and at the wrong time as rain halted play soon after that.

FOUR! Ervine finishes off in style! Fuller outside off, Ervine goes for the reverse sweep. Gets it through the short third man region for a boundary. ZIMBABWE WIN BY 4 WICKETS AND 10 BALLS TO SPARE (DLS METHOD)!
Peter Moor walks out in the middle. Just 4 runs are required to win.

OUT! Unnecessary shot! Floats a wrong 'un outside off, Waller goes for a big hit. Gets it off the bottom half of the bat and the ball goes towards deep mid-wicket. Gunathilaka comes running in and takes a safe catch. Waller departs in search of glory. Sandakan gets his first.
Change of ends for Lakshan Sandakan.
Punched through covers for a single to keep strike.
FOUR! Sprayed way down the leg side, Waller goes for the scoop. Reaches out to it, gets his bat to it and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Top shot! Short and wide outside off, Waller camps back and smashes it through the cover region for a boundary.
Waller hoicks it over the mid-wicket fielder for a couple.
Quicker in line of the pads, Waller goes for the scoop but misses. The ball brushes the pads on it's way to the keeper.
Ervine comes down the track and mistimes his drive towards long on for a single.
Danushka Gunathilaka replaces Sandakan.
Again full and outside off, Ervine comes down the track and drives it past the bowler for a single towards long off. 16 needed off 18 balls.
Floated outside off, Waller pushes it towards the fielder at cover. the fielder there misfields and the batsmen run a single in the process.
Ervine works it through the square leg region for a single.
Fuller outside off, carved over the point region for a single.
The DLS par score at the end of this over is 187.
Too full on the pads, Ervine flicks it through the backward square leg region for a single.
Clipped through the mid-wicket region for a couple. Brilliant running by the batsmen.
Bowls a googly in line of the stumps, Ervine goes for the reverse sweep. Gets it through covers for a single. Sandakan has conceded 41 in his 3 overs.
Way wide outside off, Ervine still goes after it. Gets an inside edge to it. Beats the keeper and the batsmen run a couple.
FOUR! A bit shortish outside off, Ervine shuffles across and goes for the pull. Beats the two fielders in the deep and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Short outside off, Waller punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Five Wides! Wrong 'un down the leg side, Waller goes for the sweep but he fails to make contact. Dickwella also fails to stop it and the ball races away to the fence. 31 off 28 needed for Zimbabwe.
Ervine sweeps again, gets it towards deep square leg for a single.
10th ODI fifty for Craig Ervine!
FOUR! Beautiful shot to get to his fifty! Tossed up outside of, Ervine kneels down and sweeps it through the front of square leg region for a boundary. Good batting from Ervine.
Lakshan Sandakan is back on. He has proved expensive so far. Can he change it around for him and his team?

FOUR! Bad bowl to end the over and he pays the price for it! Short and sprayed down the leg side, Waller goes for the slog. Gets a top edge on it and the ball flies through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Waller smashes it hard back to the bowler who makes a brilliant stop.
Loopy outside off, Waller drives it back to the bowler.
Short and wide outside off, Waller cuts it past the point fielder for a couple.
Malcolm Waller strides out to bat. Zimbabwe need 47 off 34 balls.

OUT! The bowling change has worked! They say catches win matches and this could be an example of it. Floats it in the line of the stumps, Raza goes hard at it. Hammers it straight back to the bowler. Hasaranga hops and puts his hand in the air and the ball sticks. Raza cannot believe it but he cannot do anything now. Hasaranga has given Sri Lanka a breathing space. Can he strike again?
Fuller in line of the stumps, driven towards the fielder at covers.
Wanidu Hasaranga comes on to bowl now. It has gone much darker now.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. Now, 5 overs are allowed outside the circle.
Angling across, Raza works it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller outside off, Ervine drives it through covers for a single.

FOUR! Ervine is taking Gunaratne on! Fuller in line of the stumps, Ervine goes over mid on again and hits it beautifully for a boundary. Smart batting from Ervine after watching that long on is inside the circle.
SIX! Pressure relieved! Short around off, Ervine camps back and smacks that over the long on region for a maximum.
A bit flatter and outside off, Ervine goes to cut it but he misses it again.
Slower outside off, Ervine goes for a drive but he fails to make contact.
Low full toss around leg, Raza blocks it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery angling into the batsman, Raza steers it through the backward point region for a couple.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Raza drives but straight to the fielder at covers. An inch wide either sides and he could have a boundary there.
FOUR! Slashed hard! Length delivery outside off, Raza pounces on that length as he throws the kitchen sink at it. Gets it over the jumping point fielder for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Ervine throws his bat at it. Gets it through covers for a single.
Raza punches it towards cover-point for a single.
Raza stays in his crease and flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Good length delivery around off, Ervine pushes it towards mid on for  a single.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary! Fires that full into the stumps, Ervine somehow manages to get his bat to it. Gets an inside edge to it and the ball races past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Around the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Sikandar Raza strides out to bat. He will need a outing similar to the first match to take his side across the finish line.

OUT! Gunaratne strikes! Slower delivery outside off, Williams comes down the track and goes for a big hit. He misses it completely and Dickwella is quick to collect the ball. He dislodges the bails and starts celebrating. Umpire checks upstairs for sideline no ball but Asela is fine. Sri Lanka know how crucial a wicket this is and they are ecstatic. Pressure getting the better of experienced Williams. Zimbabwe now require 74 runs off 52 balls.
Shorter around off, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Asela Gunaratne comes on.

NOT OUT! Good length delivery outside off, Ervine pushes it towards covers and rushes for a single. Gunaratne is quick to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end. He hits and the players go up in unison. The umpire goes upstairs to check it. Replays show that Ervine just made it in time. So a run taken successfully.
Asela Gunaratne has scored a direct hit at the bowler's end. Craig Ervine seems to be in danger as umpire Llong refers it upstairs.

FOUR! Fuller outside off, Ervine drives again but gets it through the gap in covers this time. Gunathilaka tries to cut it off with a desperate dive in the deep but the ball wins the race to the fence.
Length delivery outside off, Ervine prods forward in defence.
Good length delivery outside off, the ball stays low. Ervine swings across the line but gets beaten.
Fuller outside off, Ervine drives it beautifully towards short cover. The fielder there dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Good length delivery around off, Ervine gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
The players and umpires are back out in the middle. Craig Ervine and Sean Williams will continue with the bat for Zimbabwe. Dushmantha Chameera will begin the proceedings with the ball for Sri Lanka.

Update 1710 local time - So we have got the much awaited news for you and yes it is a positive one. The umpires after inspecting the ground have decided to resume the game at 1720 local. ZIMBABWE NEED 80 RUNS OFF 60 BALLS. Powerplay 3 will take place from 25th to 31st over. One bowler can bowl a maximum of 7 overs. Bad light will also be a key factor here.
Update 1645 local time - Good news, folks! The rain has stopped and the groundstaff are working hard. INSPECTION WILL TAKE PLACE AT 1700 LOCAL.
Update 1630 local time - It's still raining and it looks as if we are for a big delay. Sri Lankan fans won't like this and would pray that the rain clears soon and we get on with the game.

Update 1545 local time - PLAY HALTED - It has started raining and the covers are on the field. As the players made their way off the field, some of the Sri Lankan players were seen having some animated chat with Sean Williams. Hope it was just a regular conversation. Let's hope that the rain clears soon and we get on with the game. ZIMBABWE ARE CURRENTLY AHEAD OF DLS PAR SCORE AT THIS STAGE BY 9 RUNS! Also remember, the floodlights can't be used in this series.
Fuller outside off, Ervine defends it off the bottom half and the ball rolls towards the slip cordon.
Fuller around off, driven towards long off for a single.
Ervine lunges forward and defends it neatly.
Fuller outside off, Williams drives it towards long off for a single.
Clipped through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Fires this around off, Williams prods forward in defence.
Danushka Gunathilaka is brought in for a bowl.
Length delivery outside off, Ervine prods forward in defence. 20 overs completed and a result is now a certain.
Good length delivery outside off, Ervine gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
Length delivery outside off, Ervine swings hard at it but fails to make contact there. Luckily he did not edge it.
Good length delivery outside off, Ervine shoulders his arms to it.
Halt in play as a substitute comes running in with a handkerchief for Mathews to dry the ball.
Fuller around leg, Ervine clips it through the backward square leg region for a couple.
Slower delivery around leg, Williams clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.

Lasith Malinga is called on for a bowl. The Lankan players are taking their merry time to get on with the game. All eyes on the umpire on what their call is. The DLS par score after 20 overs is 127 and if a wicket falls, then it will be 149.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Williams defends it on the off side with soft hands for a quick single.
Short and wide outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Gunaratne loses the ball as he was just about to bowl.
Bowls it fuller in line of the stumps, Ervine gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
The groundstaff are ready with the covers at the fence.
Fuller outside off, Williams clips it towards wide mid on for a single.
Williams lunges forward and defends it on the off side.
Length delivery outside off, clipped through square leg for a single.
Asela Gunaratne is back on.
Sean Williams is the next man in.

OUT! Chameera strikes! Musakanda was going great but he now has to walk back to the hut! Back of a length delivery outside off, kicks a bit off the deck. Musakanda tries to run it down towards the third man fielder but he only manages a faint edge. The ball flies straight to Dickwella who does not make any mistake. He celebrates in joy and Sri Lanka have got a vital wicket.
Slower delivery on a length outside off, Musakanda prods forward in defence.
FOUR! That was beautiful! Good length delivery outside off, Musakanda uses the pace of the ball and steers it through the backward point region for a boundary. A treat to watch.
FOUR! Clobbered! Full outside off, Musakanda leans into this one and mills it through the wide mid off region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Musakanda gets drawn into the drive. He throws his bat at it but he fails to make contact.
Wide! Short and wide outside off, Musakanda still goes after it but cannot make contact. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Good length delivery outside off, Musakanda defends it towards the fielder at point.
Time for Drinks!

NOT OUT it is! Wrong one around leg, Ervine is beaten and gets off-balanced in the process. Dickwella doesn't collect it but the ball deflects off him onto the stumps. He appeals and the umpire goes upstairs. The replay shows that Ervine's leg was grounded for the whole time. Wide is not give as well so the ball might have brushed Craig's pads on its way.
The umpire has gone upstairs to check for a stumping appeal against Craig Ervine. Seems not out though.
Musakanda whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish delivery, Musakanda plays a reverse pulls it fine down the off side. A brace is taken.
FOUR! Full on the stumps, Musakanda kneels down and sweeps it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. They are not lettying their foot off the pedal.
Tossed up outside off, pushed off the front foot on the off side for a single.
It's gone really dark there. We cannot use the lights though.
Shortish delivery outside off, Ervine looks to cut it but misses as the ball stays low.
Wide! This time down the leg side. Another wide.
Wide! Served wide outside off, Ervine first things of leaving but then goes after it. Misses and gets a wide.
Slower one on a length around off, Musakanda fails to pick it but is lucky to have got an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length delivery, punched on the up to backward point.
Full on off, pushed off the front foot to extra cover.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Musakanda looks to go after it  but misses.
On a length on middle, defended with soft hands on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery, pushed to covers.
Dushmantha Chameera is back on.
FOUR! Crafty! Tossed up around leg, Musakanda kneels down and sweeps it through backward square leg. Gets it in the gap again and finds the fence as well. What a start this, for Zimbabwe.
Googly outside off, glided off the outer half in the third man region for couple.
Tossed up outside off, spinning in. Musakanda looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Slower through the air, gently worked in the square leg region for a single.

FOUR! Short delivery outside off, spinning in. Ervine goes for the back foot punch. Gets a healthy edge and the ball runs fine past the keeper. Mathews tries chasing it down from short third man, gets to the ball but fails to keep it in. A boundary is signaled. 100 up for Zimbabwe.
Served around leg, straightens a touch, Ervine works it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Lakshan Sandakan is introduced into the attack.
Musakanda predetermines and reverse sweeps it on the full. Gets it through the short third man region for a brace.
Loopy delivery, pushed down to long on for a single.
Tossed up delivery, turned to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Boundaries are still coming! Full delivery, Ervine kneels down and sweeps it superbly through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Ervine prods forward and blocks it on the off side.
Googly from Wanidu, Ervine plays with soft hands. Gets an outside edge to short third man.
Musakanda stays in the crease and keeps it out.
Full around off, milked down to long off for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shortish delivery, pulled to mid on.
It has gone much darker now. The par score at the end of 20-overs is 109-2. Zimbabwe are nicely going at a good pace to achieve that.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, Ervine pushes with soft hands on the off side for a single.
Ervine nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Craig Erwine walks out to the middle.

OUT! Poor shot selection! After playing so well, Mire decides to scoop this low full toss. Ends up placing it straight into the hands of Mathews at short fine leg. The Lankan skipper doesn't make any mistake and sends the opener back in the hut. Hasaranga has got the hosts back into the game

Mix-up in the middle! Mire taps it off the back foot on the off side. Both the batsmen take off for a run but then hesitate and  decide to go back. The throw from the fielder is at the bowler's end but by that time Musakanda is back home. No harm done!
Four Byes! Full outside off, the ball stays low. Mire kneels down to sweep but misses. The ball goes through the gap between Dickwella's legs to the fence behind. Four unnecessary runs, these!
Musakanda gets down on one knee, paddle scoops it on the full towards short fine leg. A single is taken.
Musakanda eases it down to long off for a single.
Leg bye! Mire looks to reverse sweep the full delivery but misses. The ball brushes the pads and goes towards short third man. A leg bye is taken.
Served around leg, flicked on the leg side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Another one! Full on the stumps, Mire kneels down and slog sweeps it in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now a maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
FOUR! Another shortish delivery, finds the fence again. Musakanda goes back and whacks it over wide mid on for a boundary. The wicket doesn't seem to slow the ZIM batsmen down.
Wrong one outside off, stays low. Musakanda adjusts well and pushes on the off side.
Tarasai Musakanda is the next man in.

OUT! Timber! Hasaranga strikes! A wrong 'un around off. Masakadza fails to pick it. Goes for a drive away from his body. The ball sneaks through the gap and disturbs the woodwork. Hasaranga is delighted and so are his teammates. A much-needed breakthrough this for Sri Lanka.
Mire turns it wide of mid on for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery, punished! Another shortish delivery, a wrong one. Mire pulls it with disdain over mid-wicket and collects another boundary. Every Lankan bowler is getting a beating today.
Shortish delivery, Mire mistimes his pull to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat on the leg side.

FOUR! Swept away! Full around leg, Masakadza kneels down and sweeps it nicely through backward square leg. Mendis in the deep, runs to his right, puts in a dive but fails to cut it off. Zimbabwe openers are cruising through at the moment.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Masakadza stays slightly leg sidish. Gets it off the inner half on the leg side. A single is taken.
Around leg, punched back to the bowler.
Served fuller on the pads, flicked square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
Punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Full on the stumps, swept through backward square leg for a single. Slight fumble there but no harm done.

FOUR! Good execution! Masakadza dances down the track. Hasaranga spots that and drags his length back. Ends up being a half-tracker and Hamilton whips it off the toe end over wide mid on for a boundary.
Hamilton stays in the crease and pushes to cover-point.
Shout for lbw! Full outside off, Masakadza gets a long way across to sweep but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but it's turned down. Impact outside off there.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Wanidu Hasaranga to bowl next.
On the pads, clipped off the inner half to short fine leg.
Served around leg, defended down the track.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Chance of a run out! Served around leg, Mire works it behind square on the leg side. Fernando from short fine leg, gets to his left and seeing Mire far out, has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single is taken. The replays shows, that had the throw hit, Mire was a goner by miles. No idea why Asela didn't collect the throw to take off the bails.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for a single.
Slower through the air around leg, Masakadza fails to flick it through and gets rapped on the pads.
Asela Gunaratne to replace Lasith Malinga into the attack.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Streaky! Back of a length delivery around off, Masakadza looks to punch it on the off side. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball runs fine down to the third man fence. Runs are flowing!
Hamilton stays in the crease and blocks it out.
FOUR! Width on offer and punished! Back of a length delivery outside off, Masakadza cuts it away fiercely past the backward point fielder for a boundary. ZIM are off to a flier!
A touch ahead of a length outside off, pushed to mid off.
Dushmantha Chameera is introduced into the attack.

SIX! My goodness! That came out of nowhere! Back of a length delivery, angling in. Mire latches onto it in a flash. Pulls it away and makes a clean connection. Gets value for it as the ball sails into the stands for a maximum. That made a superb sound.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Shortish delivery outside off, defended down the wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length delivery on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Slanting into the pads, Masakadza plays it with the angle through wide mid on. The sluggish outfield slows the ball down. Three runs taken.
FOUR! It's too easy for Mire at the moment. Full outside off, Mire lofts it over mid off to collect another boundary. 14 runs off the over and Fernando has a debut to forget so far.

FOUR! Mistimed but into the gap! Short and angling in. Mire goes for the pull. Is slightly early into his shot and ends up miscuing it in the deep mid-wicket region. Tharanga there, runs to his right but fails to reach it. The ball bounces and trickles down to the fence. Hitting with the wind saved him there.

Falls just safe! A touch ahead of a length outside off. Solomon looks to loft it on the up over covers. Gets it off the toe just over the extra cover fielder. It's wide of the cover fielder and a brace is taken.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed to point.
FOUR! In the gap! Full and straight, Mire shimmies across and flicks it elegantly through wide mid on for a boundary.
On a good length around off, Mire gets across and punches it to mid off.
FOUR! Put away! Straying on the pads, Masakadza flicks it off the meat over mid-wicket for a boundary. His first one and that's first runs conceded by Malinga today.

In the air... safe! Angling into the pads, Masakadza looks to flick it across the line but gets a leading edge. The ball lobs in the extra cover region, eludes the diving fielder there by just. Mid off covers it up. No runs taken.
On a length around off, tapped back to the bowler.
Length delivery, angling in, punched to mid on.
Beaten! On a good length outside off, nips away after pitching. Masakadza once again feels for it but gets beaten all ends up. Malinga is having a gala time against Hamilton.
Wide outside off, Masakadza fails to cash in on it. Mistimes his punch to covers.
Full around off, Solomon prods forward and pushes to mid off.
Straight on middle, Hamilton shuffles across and flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Masakadza gets across and taps it on the off side.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, tucked to mid-wicket.
Better this time. It's a full outswinger around off, Mire glides it off the toe end to third man for a single.

SIX! Welcome to the international arena, Asitha Fernando! Gets his line completely wrong. Bowls a back of a length delivery, angling down leg. Mire pulls it with disdain over long leg for a maximum. That will make up for the first maiden over.
Asitha Fernando to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
On a length outside off, shaping away a touch. Masakadza looks to defend it but gets a bottom edge into the ground and towards the keeper. MAIDEN TO START OFF!
Shortish delivery around off, Hamilton looks to play it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Another full outswinger, pushed gently to mid off.
Back of a length delivery outside off. This one also moves away from the batsman, who leaves it watchfully.
Another outswinger, this time on the fuller side. Pushed to cover-point.

What a ball to start off! Almost catches the outside edge. Pitches it on a good length around off, shapes away beautifully. Masakadza feels for it but gets beaten by the away movement. Nearly a wicket off the first ball.

Welcome back for the chase! The players and umpires are making their way out in the middle. Hamilton Masakadza and Solomon Mire will open the batting for Zimbabwe. Lasith Malinga will start the proceedings with the first new ball for Sri Lanka.
